request.questionText: Some University of Hogwarts stakeholders have expressed concern that the Ministry responsible for state governance is interfering with academic affairs. One point of contention is a perceived lack of minority representation at the senior leadership level. At the University of Hogwarts, 2 of the 18 college Deans identify as a member of a minority racial or ethnic group. Research provides a national baseline suggesting that people of color held 30% of top leadership roles in higher education during the year 2023. Use Monte Carlo simulation with 100000 iterations to calculate a p-value under the null hypothesis that Hogwarts' leadership demographics are indistinguishable from the baseline rate for academic institutions. What is the estimated p-value? Enter your p-value in percentage units OR decimal format. For example, for a p-value equal to thirteen percent, enter 13 or 0.13.
